### Ultra-Large Capacity for Higher Delivery Efficiency

Adjustable up to four compartments, each accessible independently, serving up to 4 locations' diverse needs.

[Video 13](https://storage.keenon.cn/uploads/20260722/11f0414f7a194c32b011ad01f3e594c8.mp4)

[Video 14](https://storage.keenon.cn/uploads/20260722/f42d10de93de6abf4d74527d079b5e22.mp4)

### Safe & Hygienic & Private

Automatic doors and ventilation ensure contactless, hygienic dish service, prioritizing privacy and spill prevention.

### The IoT Elevator Rider & 3D Obstacle Avoidance

The BUTLERBOT W3 can now take the elevator for item delivery, streamlining business processes.  
 Optimal avoidance and remarkable continuous bend passability, conquering any complex environment
